profile.headline: Lead SWE @ Docusign | MSc Data Science @ UT Austin | Data, Cloud, Infra, Privacy | Ex Microsoft, Twitter
profile.summary:
Software engineer leading the Data Platform powering Docusign.
Experience in infrastructure, cloud computing, big data processing, developer experience, and observability.
MSc in Data Science - UT Austin.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading Data Platform infra @ DocuSign.
* Leading a team of 5 geo-distributed software and data engineers in charge of end-to-end infrastructure and code for dataset management, ingestion, querying, and reporting.
* Designed and implemented a pipeline capable of ingesting 100s of TB of on prem data, and building a delta lake in the cloud enabling efficient processing, querying and secure access.
* Collaborated closely with Reporting, ML infra, Security, and CLM leadership to accomplish Docusign's objectives in a correct and timely manner.
* Lead data governance, privacy, compliance, and multi-tenancy efforts across our platform.
* Drive technical decision-making directly with Directors of Engineering and Staff+ Engineers. Accountable of key metrics for Data Platform during service reliability reviews with Sr Directors/VP.
* Helped grow the Data Platform team from 4 to 11 engineers across infra, services, and data engineering, both in USA and India.
* Ensured observability was achieved across storage and compute, allowing us to make decisions on performance, usage, and cost across our org and withing individual workflows on each team.
* Develop and manage secure, reliable, and highly available compute and storage infrastructure using Terraform.
* Enabled monitoring, alerting, and improving our CI/CD pipelines to ensure building, testing, and planning across all environments, performing static analysis and OSS scanning. Set up our live-site strategy.
* Improved customer onboarding by automating infrastructure deployment, reducing onboarding time from 1 week to 1 day and then as self-service, allowing us to easily grow from 2 to more than 10 supported teams/scenarios across 5 different environments and 6 regions.
* Design and develop batch and streaming data pipelines for large scale analytics using Spark and Python in Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Engineering Effectiveness - Measurement Tooling
Tech Lead for the EEMT team, which is in charge of a telemetry pipeline for processing Twitter's internal tools, and enabling data analysis for datasets related to Twitter effectiveness.
* Drive setting the vision, mission, strategy and planning for the team, in alignment with our organization's multi-year objectives.
* In charge of project and team management, mentorship and team's growth. Ensured team was funded and assigned 3 engineers.
* Developing and maintaining an end-to-end telemetry pipeline, all the way from collection to ingestion, schematization, and visualization of tool usage and performance logs. Using Python, Scala, and BigQuery.
* Building a data warehouse for enabling analysis on engineering productivity and effectiveness, by ingesting different datasets from different source formats, adding consistency across datasets, and incorporating privacy best practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering Effectiveness - SDLC Tooling
Helped develop and maintain the quality of a graph database aimed to understand all of Twitter's processes, assets, and resources.
* Incorporated data quality improvements for the creation of the graph, deployed and managed in Neo4j.
* Improved development and documentation processes, and drove the team's agile ceremonies.
* Put together the team's interview questions and rubrics and drove several TPS, coding, CR, and design interviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Azure Edge + Platform - Enterprise Data Platform
Built and designed data pipelines able to process Terabytes of information per day.
* I gained experience across the entire pipeline architecture, including:
       Data collection configuration, data processing and routing, data quality and retention, alert and monitoring, pipeline reliability, disaster recovery, and deployment.
* Skilled in Spark, Scala, .NET, and different Azure technologies (HDInsights, ADLS Gen2, KeyVault, - EventHubs, CosmosDB, AAD, LogAnalytics, Application Insights, among others).
* In charge of organizing monthly demos to improve both technical and non-technical knowledge sharing related to our group's scope and vision.
* Experience as a mentor for both intern and full-time engineers. In charge of designing a work plan to allow them to onboard quickly and achieve success.

positions.title: Software Engineer

framework, working with technologies like IMS, RCS, eSIM, device provisioning and Wi-Fi Calling.

Currently in charge of creating and managing job descriptions for new omegaUp interns in the technology department, reporting charges, and paying invoices.
Helped oversee the activities of the Mentors and Career Experiences programs, both related to growing and recognizing our users, and helping us getting closer to our mission of increasing the number of talented Software Engineers in Latin America.
